question:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The firefighters tried their best to __extinguish__ the fire
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'put out'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"put out"** means to extinguish something, especially a fire. (बुझाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The firefighters were able to put out the fire quickly.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'put out'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Put in** (लगाना/डालना): To install or insert something.

 
 
• **Example:** The workers put in a new floor in the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Put off** (स्थगित करना): To postpone something to a later time.
 
 
• **Example:** The event was put off due to bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Put on** (पहनना/बढ़ना): To wear or gain something.
 
 
• **Example:** She put on her glasses to read the document.
